# Forever Classmate

![Forever Classmate — golden compass crest with nine class-colored gems](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tomqwu/wow_forever_classmate/main/assets/branding/forever-classmate-logo.png)

**One compact, class-aware companion for World of Warcraft: Forever.**

**[Build addons for Forever](https://tomqwu.github.io/wow_forever_classmate/)** is the companion GitHub Pages guide to the client API, safe reads, beta pitfalls, testing, and release practices.

Forever Classmate supports all nine classes. Forever Classmate detects the player class and starts only that module; other class modules create no frames, events, or polling. Every module has separate saved settings while movement, locking, scale, minimap access, and combat fading remain consistent. Full bars use the same 426-pixel rendered width as Forever's default desktop Main Hand swing timer; Hunters can switch to a 42-pixel range icon.

The interface follows the WoW client language: English and Simplified Chinese (`zhCN`) labels for bars, settings, warnings, and tooltips. Spell and character names come from the client; curated rare-pet names may remain in English. Spell tracking also works on Chinese clients: every tracked spell and aura carries its Chinese name from the Forever client's own spell table. Other client locales use English.

## Class companions

| Class | Live helper |
| --- | --- |
| Hunter | Range brackets and validated yards, or an optional red/green range icon; ammo, target of target, facing ("12° left"), Hunter's Mark, aspect (including Cheetah or Pack left on in combat), pet care, family guidance and optional player Inspect |
| Shaman | Four totem slots with live or marked estimated timers, weapon imbue with charges (including a dual-wielded off-hand weapon), elemental shield with its last charge in red, mana, Totemic Recall, and learned Maelstrom, Riptide, Lightning Mastery, Stormstrike and Totemic Call cues |
| Paladin | Mana, active seal by name and time, your aura, blessings and Righteous Fury, target judgments, Unsealed Wrath, and learned Holy Strike, Holy Shock and Consecration readiness |
| Warrior | Rage, your stance by name, shout upkeep, Rend, Deep Wounds, Sunder Armor, Thunder Clap, Demoralizing Shout and Hamstring, Enrage and Flurry, and learned cues including Overpower, Slam, Reckless Swings and Bloodrage |
| Rogue | Energy, combo points, poison on each weapon with time left, Slice and Dice, Poised and Venom procs, your poisons, bleeds and Expose Armor on the target, and reactive abilities |
| Druid | Current form and its live power, combo points in Cat Form, Mark of the Wild, Thorns and Omen of Clarity with its Clearcasting proc, target bleeds and DoTs, readable procs, plus Primal Bite and Shifting Power |
| Mage | Live mana meter, armor and absorb-shield status, Fire Vulnerability and other target setup, Hot Streak, Fingers of Frost, Clearcasting, Arcane Blast stacks and Missile Barrage, and learned abilities when ready |
| Priest | Mana, Shadowform, Inner Fire, Fortitude, Divine Spirit and Shadow Protection upkeep, Shadow target effects, Penance, Inner Focus and other learned abilities, and Forever's race-specific Priest spells |
| Warlock | Mana, soul shards, armor, demon presence and health (or your Demonic Sacrifice buff), every target DoT and curse, Nightfall's Shadow Trance proc, and learned abilities including Amplify Curse |

The seven standard class bars discover every learned active racial and surface the one most useful now, while hover details list the others. This includes Forever racials such as Will to Survive, Elune's Light, Eureka!, Shatter Curse, Read Ley Line, and Skysight, plus the twelve race-specific Priest spells. “Context” means the game currently reports the racial unusable; the addon does not guess why.

Resource percentages use Forever’s native percent API when exact power values are restricted. Class cues come from the live spellbook and aura/cooldown APIs. They adapt to learned talents without hardcoded Classic spell IDs and do not infer a specialization, prescribe a fixed rotation, or cast anything. When the client cannot supply a useful live state, its bar status disappears; confirmed observations and explicit cast-based estimates remain visible.

Warrior, Rogue, Druid, Priest, and Warlock can show **slim multi-target DoT bars** to the right of the main bar. Each row identifies an enemy, your active effect, and its readable remaining time. The strip tracks the current target and nearby enemies that have active nameplates; it clears a row when the effect expires or its nameplate disappears. It cannot continue tracking an offscreen enemy whose aura state Forever no longer exposes. Turn it off with **Show multi-target DoT bars** in your class settings. The original 426 × 56 bar stays the same size.

Warlock armor is confirmed out of combat. Learned spells are recognized by their English or Simplified Chinese names, even when English spell-name lookup is unavailable. A confirmed missing armor buff shows "Missing" with the armor's name in an amber warning frame at full opacity; buffing clears it. If combat hides the aura, the upkeep slot can keep the last confirmed armor icon dimmed without status text or an active claim. Other standard-class upkeep slots hide an unreadable count, and target, ability, racial, or resource slots disappear when no useful live state can be read.

**Expanded bar:** the full bar uses the same engraved frame as the compact card, tinted in your class color, with your class crest set half into its left edge. Engraved dividers separate the slots, and slot icons sit in matching engraved frames. Confirmed missing buffs (armor, Hunter's Mark, aspect, Shaman imbue and shield) switch to the amber warning frame with an ember halo, and the whole frame warms to amber while a warning is confirmed. Food and sleeping bag reminders sit in a small tab of amber cells above the bar's right end, clear of the lock and slots. Each slot names what it shows: the missing buff ("Missing / Thorns"), the active one with its time, the target effect, the ready ability and your racial, instead of generic labels or abbreviations. The resource slot is visual: a power meter in its own color, then the shard icon with its count, five combo pips, or your stance or form icon; exact numbers are on hover. Rogue poisons are tracked per weapon, Warlock upkeep shows demon health, Shaman imbue charges appear on the cell, and Hunter facing reads "12° left". Slot positions and the 426 × 56 bar are unchanged.

**Foldable bar:** click the small **<** button to fold the bar into a compact card. A large painted crest for your class sits on top, breaking through the card's upper edge with a soft class-colored glow, and stays readable outside combat. Below an engraved divider, confirmed missing buffs appear in one row of up to four equal cells. One engraved frame, tinted in your class color, surrounds the crest and cells. Each cell keeps its own bright amber frame and a warm ember halo around a dark well with the icon inset, so warnings stand out and food, sleeping bag and class icons line up whatever their art. A neutral stat cell leads the row with the one number each class watches most: Hunter ammo, Warlock soul shards, Shaman Ankhs (once Reincarnation is learned), Mage conjured water, Rogue shortest poison time, mana % for Paladin, Priest and Druid, and health % for Warrior. Zero shards, water or Ankhs and low ammo turn red. **Show class stat in compact card** turns it off. With no stat and no warnings the card disappears and only the glowing crest remains. The crest stays where you placed it; the card grows below and around it. Each warning clears when its buff returns, its option is disabled, or its reading becomes unavailable; existing level and combat rules apply. The crest identifies the class only and never claims a buff is active or missing. Hover lists every warning; when more than four are confirmed, the fourth cell shows how many more are hidden. **Flash missing buffs** gently pulses the cell frames and halos, never the icons; with it off, the halo stays steady. Click the card to expand, or unlock to drag. The expanded 426 × 56 bar remains inside its shared 450 × 64 frame; hiding the collapse button removes its 16-pixel rail (434 × 64). The expanded outline turns amber for confirmed warnings, and its art fades with the bar's actual opacity. **Fold outside combat, expand in combat** (off by default) switches views automatically: entering combat bursts the full bar out with a class-colored flare, and leaving combat drops the card back in. A click still overrides it until the next combat change, and an unreadable combat state never switches on its own. Dying folds an expanded bar down to the crest, shown faded inside a slowly breathing pale spirit glow, and it expands again on revival; a card you folded yourself stays folded. **Collapsed warning icon** and **Show collapse button** are independent settings. The shared container owns position and size; legacy WoW layout-cache entries cannot independently move its contents.

**Titan Panel and data brokers:** Classmate publishes a LibDataBroker source, so Titan Panel (or ChocolateBar, Bazooka and other broker displays) can show it. The plugin shows your class crest, the same stat as the compact card (Soul Shards, mana, ammo and so on) and the first confirmed missing buff (`+N` for more), or `Off` when the class bar is disabled. Its tooltip lists everything; left-click opens settings and right-click folds or expands the bar. It only mirrors what the bar already confirmed, adds no polling, and does nothing if no broker display is installed. Turning off **Compact stat** also removes the stat from the panel.

**Minimap button tray:** with **Group addon minimap buttons** on (the default), other addons' minimap buttons move into a framed tray behind the Classmate button, so it is the only icon around the map. Hover over Classmate to open the tray: the first cell opens Classmate settings, followed by every collected button in name order. Left-click Classmate still opens settings directly. Buttons keep their own clicks and tooltips; clicking one closes the tray, which also closes after two seconds away or with Escape. Only named, unprotected addon launchers (LibDBIcon, ForeverCore and similar) are collected. Blizzard minimap controls, map pins and protected frames are never touched, and nothing moves during combat. Turn the option off, or hide the Classmate button, to return every button to its original spot with its own dragging restored.

## Mail recipients

Opening **Send Mail** shows a compact side panel with **Alts** and **Recent recipients**. Click a name to fill the recipient field, or right-click to forget its saved entry. Both lists have pagination; recents keep the newest 20 successful recipients for the current realm and faction, shared across your characters. Lists and recipient filling preserve the full **first name + surname**. Recent addresses are kept exactly as observed on a successful send; surnames are never treated as realm suffixes.

Log into each alt once with Classmate and its mail feature enabled to record it. After upgrading from 0.30.0, log into each alt again to replace its incomplete old name. Old first-name-only suggestions stay hidden until refreshed. The alt list shows other recorded characters on your current realm and faction; it does not discover unplayed characters from the account roster. Each alt row shows the class crest, the name in class color, and the level and gold from that character's last login; the Alts heading totals the gold of this character and its listed alts. Each character's own class, level and gold are saved at login, on level-up and when its money changes. No mail subject, body, items, or gold sent are stored. Character and recipient records use the existing account-wide saved variables.

Toggle **Mail recipients: alts and recents** in `/fclassmate` settings independently of the class bar. The panel appears only beside the native Send Mail tab, hides in combat, and uses no polling. It fills the selected name; sending remains the normal game action.

## Setup and commands

Install the `ForeverUtilities` folder into the active Forever client’s `_forever_/Interface/AddOns/` folder. Historical beta installs used `_classic_beta_/Interface/AddOns/`. The folder name and `ForeverUtilitiesDB` stay stable for upgrades. Restart WoW for first discovery or use `/reload` after an update.

Hover over the round minimap button to open the addon tray, left-click it or use the active class command to open settings. Right-click it to inspect an eligible targeted player. Drag the button around the map edge. The padlock on the bar toggles movement without disabling updates or fading.

| Command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `/fhunter`, `/fshaman`, `/fpaladin`, `/fwarrior`, `/frogue`, `/fdruid`, `/fmage`, `/fpriest`, `/fwarlock` | Open settings for that active class |
| `/fclassmate` or `/futils` | Open settings for the active class |
| `<command> unlock` / `lock` | Move or lock the active bar |
| `<command> scale 1.2` | Set scale from 0.5 to 2 |
| `<command> on` / `off` | Enable or disable the active class helper |
| `<command> fold` / `expand` | Fold the bar into the compact card or expand it |
| `<command> autofold on` / `off` | Fold outside combat and expand in combat |
| `<command> tray on` / `off` | Group other addons' minimap buttons into the tray |
| `<command> reset` | Restore that class module's defaults (the settings panel's button asks for a second click) |
| `<command> status` | Show version and live diagnostics |

Each information block can be switched independently. Bars use full opacity in combat; the Shaman bar also stays fully visible while a totem is active. Mage uses 90% opacity with a target and 75% while idle outside combat. Without an active totem, the other bars use 60% with a target and 20% while idle. A confirmed missing long-term upkeep buff keeps a standard-class bar fully visible outside combat; an unavailable reading does not. Rogue finisher buffs still use the normal fade between fights. Hovering a bar reveals it at full opacity, even while locked; leaving restores its normal fade. Unlocking does not override fading on its own.

Hunter ammo counts and low-ammo warnings respect the current weapon’s ammo eligibility when the client exposes it; no-ammo weapons and unreadable eligibility stay quiet.

Confirmed missing maintained buffs now pulse their warning border while the icon, text and bar stay readable. **Flash missing buffs** can be disabled independently in class settings to keep a static warning. Hunter aspects and Shaman shields retain their existing combat-only warning conditions. Warlock armor is confirmed outside combat; restricted readings, temporary Rogue finishers and missing pets do not trigger a pulse.

**Sleeping bag reminder:** for levels **1–59**, a Cozy Sleeping Bag cell appears in the tab above the bar (or in the compact card) when the Well-Rested buff is confirmed missing outside combat, and keeps the bar fully visible. Any active stack clears it. Level 60 and above, combat, death, and unreadable aura data hide the reminder. Disable **Sleeping bag buff reminder (below level 60)** independently in class settings; **Flash missing buffs** also controls its pulsing border. The bar keeps its size; Hunter icon-only mode places the reminder beside the range icon.

**Food XP reminder:** a separate food icon reminds levels **1–59** to eat XP-bonus food outside combat when Well Fed is confirmed absent. Seeing Well Fed clears the reminder. The XP effect is hidden, so this checks food-buff presence rather than measuring the actual bonus; choose food whose tooltip says **+5% experience from kills**. **Food XP buff reminder (below level 60)** has its own toggle. Either leveling reminder keeps the bar bright and follows **Flash missing buffs**, without changing its size.

For a minimal Hunter display, enable **Icon-only range display** in `/fhunter` settings. Green means the client confirms ranged reach and red means it confirms you cannot shoot. The locked icon hides when reach is unavailable or there is no valid hostile target; unlocking keeps a neutral icon available for dragging. Use `/fhunter unlock` to move it. **Right-click the Classmate minimap button to inspect an eligible targeted player on any class**, including Hunter icon-only mode; left-click opens settings, and hovering opens the addon tray when grouping is on. The right-click shortcut has its own per-class toggle. The optional Hunter full-bar Inspect button remains available. Pet hints describe family guidance; the selected pet's learned abilities remain unknown unless checked with Beast Lore.

Designed for the Forever 1.60.1 beta client. Automated checks use mocked APIs; live in-game validation remains ongoing as the beta changes.

[Class module behavior](https://github.com/tomqwu/wow_forever_classmate/blob/main/docs/class-modules.md) · [Shaman research](https://github.com/tomqwu/wow_forever_classmate/blob/main/docs/shaman-module.md) · [Pet guide sources](https://github.com/tomqwu/wow_forever_classmate/blob/main/docs/pet-guide-sources.md) · [Developer guide](https://github.com/tomqwu/wow_forever_classmate/blob/main/docs/development.md) · [Release history](https://github.com/tomqwu/wow_forever_classmate/blob/main/docs/changelog.md)

# Forever Classmate v0.45.0

## What changed

- **Titan Panel support.** Classmate now publishes a LibDataBroker plugin named **Classmate**, so Titan Panel (and ChocolateBar, Bazooka or any other broker bar) can show it. It shows your class crest, the same stat as the compact card (Soul Shards, mana, ammo, poison time and so on) and the first confirmed missing buff with `+N` for more, or `Off` when the class bar is disabled.
- Hover the plugin for the class, stat and every confirmed warning. Left-click opens settings; right-click folds or expands the bar (not while dead).
- The plugin only mirrors what the bar already confirmed. It adds no polling and updates only when something changes. Without a broker display installed nothing appears.
- Embeds the standard LibStub, CallbackHandler-1.0 and LibDataBroker-1.1 libraries, unmodified.

Use `/reload`. Automated checks use mocked APIs; still needs in-game confirmation with Titan Panel installed.

---

# Forever Classmate

**One compact, class-aware companion for World of Warcraft: Forever.**

Forever Classmate detects your class and shows the compact information that class needs, in one engraved bar that folds into a small card when you don't need it. It supports all nine classes. Only your class's module runs; the others create no frames, events or polling. Every class keeps its own saved settings.

The interface follows the WoW client language: English and Simplified Chinese (`zhCN`). Spell and character names come from the client. Spell tracking works on Chinese clients too: every spell and aura the addon watches is matched by its Chinese name from the Forever client's own spell table. Other locales use English.

## Highlights

- **Engraved class bar.** A 426 × 56 bar (the width of Forever's default swing timer) in an engraved frame tinted in your class color, with your class crest set half into its left edge. Your resource is a colored meter (blue mana, red rage, yellow energy) with your shard count, combo pips or stance icon beside it, and the other slots name what they show, like "Ready / Overpower", "12s / Rend", "Missing / Thorns" or "28m / Seal of Command".
- **Compact card.** Fold the bar into a small card: your class crest on top, then one class stat and any confirmed missing buffs, each in a matching framed cell with an ember glow.
- **Class stat at a glance.** The card always shows the number your class watches most: Hunter ammo, Warlock soul shards, Shaman Ankhs, Mage conjured water, Rogue poison time, mana for Paladin, Priest and Druid, and health for Warrior.
- **Fold outside combat, expand in combat.** Optional automatic switching with a class-colored flare as the bar bursts out or the card drops in.
- **Titan Panel support.** A broker plugin shows your class stat and any missing buff on Titan Panel or another broker bar.
- **One minimap icon.** Other addons' minimap buttons gather into a tray that opens when you hover over the Classmate button.
- **Leveling reminders** for the sleeping bag and XP food buffs below level 60, and an **alt and recent recipient list** beside Send Mail.

## Class companions

| Class | Live helper |
| --- | --- |
| Hunter | Range brackets and validated yards, or an optional red/green range icon; ammo, target of target, facing ("12° left"), Hunter's Mark, aspect (including Cheetah or Pack left on in combat), pet care, family guidance and optional player Inspect |
| Shaman | Four totem slots with live or marked estimated timers, weapon imbue with charges (including a dual-wielded off-hand weapon), elemental shield with its last charge in red, mana, Totemic Recall, and learned Maelstrom, Riptide, Lightning Mastery, Stormstrike and Totemic Call cues |
| Paladin | Mana, active seal by name and time, your aura, blessings and Righteous Fury, target judgments, Unsealed Wrath, and learned Holy Strike, Holy Shock and Consecration readiness |
| Warrior | Rage, your stance by name, shout upkeep, Rend, Deep Wounds, Sunder Armor, Thunder Clap, Demoralizing Shout and Hamstring, Enrage and Flurry, and learned cues including Overpower, Slam, Reckless Swings and Bloodrage |
| Rogue | Energy, combo points, poison on each weapon with time left, Slice and Dice, Poised and Venom procs, your poisons, bleeds and Expose Armor on the target, and reactive abilities |
| Druid | Current form and its live power, combo points in Cat Form, Mark of the Wild, Thorns and Omen of Clarity with its Clearcasting proc, target bleeds and DoTs, readable procs, plus Primal Bite and Shifting Power |
| Mage | Live mana meter, armor and absorb-shield status, Fire Vulnerability and other target setup, Hot Streak, Fingers of Frost, Clearcasting, Arcane Blast stacks and Missile Barrage, and learned abilities when ready |
| Priest | Mana, Shadowform, Inner Fire, Fortitude, Divine Spirit and Shadow Protection upkeep, Shadow target effects, Penance, Inner Focus and other learned abilities, and Forever's race-specific Priest spells |
| Warlock | Mana, soul shards, armor, demon presence and health (or your Demonic Sacrifice buff), every target DoT and curse, Nightfall's Shadow Trance proc, and learned abilities including Amplify Curse |

The standard class bars find every active racial you have learned and show one that is ready now, by name, with the others on hover. Cooldown timers are left to the game's Cooldown Manager: an ability or racial on cooldown simply drops off the bar until it is ready again. This includes Forever racials such as Will to Survive, Elune's Light, Eureka!, Shatter Curse, Read Ley Line and Skysight. "Context" means the game reports that ability unusable right now; the addon does not guess why.

Everything comes from your live spellbook, auras and cooldowns, so it adapts to the talents you have learned. Classmate never casts anything, never prescribes a rotation, and never shows a guess as fact: when the game doesn't report a value, that slot stays empty rather than showing a placeholder.

Warrior, Rogue, Druid, Priest and Warlock can show **slim multi-target DoT bars** to the right of the main bar, for your target and enemies with visible nameplates. Turn them off with **Show multi-target DoT bars**.

## The bar

Engraved dividers separate the slots, and every icon sits in a matching frame. A confirmed missing buff (armor, seal, Hunter's Mark, aspect, Shaman imbue or shield) switches to an amber frame with an ember glow, and the whole frame warms to amber. **Flash missing buffs** gently pulses those frames; turn it off for a steady warning. Unreadable states, missing pets and temporary Rogue finishers never trigger a warning.

Bars are fully visible in combat and fade between fights: 60% with a target and 20% when idle (Mage 90% and 75% so mana and armor stay readable). A confirmed missing buff, an active Shaman totem or hovering the bar brings it back to full opacity.

## Compact card

Click the small **<** on the bar to fold it into a card. Your class crest sits on top, breaking through the card's upper edge with a soft class-colored glow. Below an engraved divider, one row holds your class stat followed by up to three confirmed missing buffs; any further warnings are counted on the last cell and listed on hover. Zero shards, water or Ankhs and low ammo show in red. With nothing to report, only the glowing crest remains. The crest stays exactly where you place it.

When you die the bar folds down to your crest, which fades to a ghostly tint inside a slowly breathing spirit glow, and it expands again when you're back on your feet. Click the card to expand again. Turn on **Fold outside combat, expand in combat** to switch automatically; a click still overrides it until your next combat change. **Show class stat in compact card**, **Collapsed warning icon** and **Show collapse button** are separate settings.

## Minimap button tray

releases.notes:
# Forever Classmate v0.44.1

## What changed

- Slot spacing on the Paladin, Warrior, Rogue, Druid, Mage, Priest and Warlock bars is rebuilt. Each slot is now a small card: the icon and its state ("Ready", "2/2", a timer) on the first row, and the name on its own row across the whole slot, so "All active", "Blood Fury" and similar names are no longer cut off.
- The resource slot is sized to what the class shows: wide enough for the Warlock shard count or the combo pips (the count no longer runs into the next slot), narrower for a single stance/form icon, and narrowest for a mana meter alone. The other four slots share the remaining width evenly.
- Slot order is now Resource, Upkeep, Ability, Racial, Target. The target slot is last, so a bar with no target no longer has an empty hole in its middle. Slots still never move during play.

Use `/reload`. Automated checks use mocked APIs; still needs in-game confirmation.

# Forever Classmate

**One compact, class-aware companion for World of Warcraft: Forever.**

Forever Classmate detects your class and shows the compact information that class needs, in one engraved bar that folds into a small card when you don't need it. It supports all nine classes. Only your class's module runs; the others create no frames, events or polling. Every class keeps its own saved settings.

The interface follows the WoW client language: English and Simplified Chinese (`zhCN`). Spell and character names come from the client. Spell tracking works on Chinese clients too: every spell and aura the addon watches is matched by its Chinese name from the Forever client's own spell table. Other locales use English.

## Highlights

- **Engraved class bar.** A 426 × 56 bar (the width of Forever's default swing timer) in an engraved frame tinted in your class color, with your class crest set half into its left edge. Your resource is a colored meter (blue mana, red rage, yellow energy) with your shard count, combo pips or stance icon beside it, and the other slots name what they show, like "Ready / Overpower", "12s / Rend", "Missing / Thorns" or "28m / Seal of Command".
- **Compact card.** Fold the bar into a small card: your class crest on top, then one class stat and any confirmed missing buffs, each in a matching framed cell with an ember glow.
- **Class stat at a glance.** The card always shows the number your class watches most: Hunter ammo, Warlock soul shards, Shaman Ankhs, Mage conjured water, Rogue poison time, mana for Paladin, Priest and Druid, and health for Warrior.
- **Fold outside combat, expand in combat.** Optional automatic switching with a class-colored flare as the bar bursts out or the card drops in.
- **One minimap icon.** Other addons' minimap buttons gather into a tray that opens when you hover over the Classmate button.
- **Leveling reminders** for the sleeping bag and XP food buffs below level 60, and an **alt and recent recipient list** beside Send Mail.

## Class companions

| Class | Live helper |
| --- | --- |
| Hunter | Range brackets and validated yards, or an optional red/green range icon; ammo, target of target, facing ("12° left"), Hunter's Mark, aspect (including Cheetah or Pack left on in combat), pet care, family guidance and optional player Inspect |
| Shaman | Four totem slots with live or marked estimated timers, weapon imbue with charges (including a dual-wielded off-hand weapon), elemental shield with its last charge in red, mana, Totemic Recall, and learned Maelstrom, Riptide, Lightning Mastery, Stormstrike and Totemic Call cues |
| Paladin | Mana, active seal by name and time, your aura, blessings and Righteous Fury, target judgments, Unsealed Wrath, and learned Holy Strike, Holy Shock and Consecration readiness |
| Warrior | Rage, your stance by name, shout upkeep, Rend, Deep Wounds, Sunder Armor, Thunder Clap, Demoralizing Shout and Hamstring, Enrage and Flurry, and learned cues including Overpower, Slam, Reckless Swings and Bloodrage |
| Rogue | Energy, combo points, poison on each weapon with time left, Slice and Dice, Poised and Venom procs, your poisons, bleeds and Expose Armor on the target, and reactive abilities |
| Druid | Current form and its live power, combo points in Cat Form, Mark of the Wild, Thorns and Omen of Clarity with its Clearcasting proc, target bleeds and DoTs, readable procs, plus Primal Bite and Shifting Power |
| Mage | Live mana meter, armor and absorb-shield status, Fire Vulnerability and other target setup, Hot Streak, Fingers of Frost, Clearcasting, Arcane Blast stacks and Missile Barrage, and learned abilities when ready |
| Priest | Mana, Shadowform, Inner Fire, Fortitude, Divine Spirit and Shadow Protection upkeep, Shadow target effects, Penance, Inner Focus and other learned abilities, and Forever's race-specific Priest spells |
| Warlock | Mana, soul shards, armor, demon presence and health (or your Demonic Sacrifice buff), every target DoT and curse, Nightfall's Shadow Trance proc, and learned abilities including Amplify Curse |

The standard class bars find every active racial you have learned and show one that is ready now, by name, with the others on hover. Cooldown timers are left to the game's Cooldown Manager: an ability or racial on cooldown simply drops off the bar until it is ready again. This includes Forever racials such as Will to Survive, Elune's Light, Eureka!, Shatter Curse, Read Ley Line and Skysight. "Context" means the game reports that ability unusable right now; the addon does not guess why.

Everything comes from your live spellbook, auras and cooldowns, so it adapts to the talents you have learned. Classmate never casts anything, never prescribes a rotation, and never shows a guess as fact: when the game doesn't report a value, that slot stays empty rather than showing a placeholder.

Warrior, Rogue, Druid, Priest and Warlock can show **slim multi-target DoT bars** to the right of the main bar, for your target and enemies with visible nameplates. Turn them off with **Show multi-target DoT bars**.

## The bar

Engraved dividers separate the slots, and every icon sits in a matching frame. A confirmed missing buff (armor, seal, Hunter's Mark, aspect, Shaman imbue or shield) switches to an amber frame with an ember glow, and the whole frame warms to amber. **Flash missing buffs** gently pulses those frames; turn it off for a steady warning. Unreadable states, missing pets and temporary Rogue finishers never trigger a warning.

Bars are fully visible in combat and fade between fights: 60% with a target and 20% when idle (Mage 90% and 75% so mana and armor stay readable). A confirmed missing buff, an active Shaman totem or hovering the bar brings it back to full opacity.

## Compact card

Click the small **<** on the bar to fold it into a card. Your class crest sits on top, breaking through the card's upper edge with a soft class-colored glow. Below an engraved divider, one row holds your class stat followed by up to three confirmed missing buffs; any further warnings are counted on the last cell and listed on hover. Zero shards, water or Ankhs and low ammo show in red. With nothing to report, only the glowing crest remains. The crest stays exactly where you place it.

When you die the bar folds down to your crest, which fades to a ghostly tint inside a slowly breathing spirit glow, and it expands again when you're back on your feet. Click the card to expand again. Turn on **Fold outside combat, expand in combat** to switch automatically; a click still overrides it until your next combat change. **Show class stat in compact card**, **Collapsed warning icon** and **Show collapse button** are separate settings.

## Minimap button tray

With **Group addon minimap buttons** on (the default), other addons' minimap buttons move into a framed tray behind the Classmate button, so it is the only icon around your map. Hover over Classmate to open the tray; its first cell opens Classmate settings. Left-click Classmate for settings and right-click to inspect your target. Buttons keep their own clicks and tooltips, and the tray closes on a click, on Escape, or two seconds after you move away.

releases.name: Forever Classmate v0.42.0
releases.notes:
# Forever Classmate v0.42.0

## What changed

Everything left from the full design and class review:

**Chinese clients**
- Spell tracking now works on Simplified Chinese clients for every class. Each spell and aura the addon watches carries its Chinese name, taken from the Forever client's own spell table (no spell IDs are built in, so it still only tracks what you've learned).

**Class coverage**
- **Paladin:** your aura is tracked (a missing aura warns), and blessings and Righteous Fury are named when missing without waking the bar.
- **Warrior:** Sunder Armor, Thunder Clap, Demoralizing Shout and Hamstring on the target; Enrage and Flurry procs; Bloodrage and Berserker Rage cues.
- **Rogue:** your Deadly, Wound, Crippling and Mind-numbing Poison on the target, plus Expose Armor. A sharpening stone now reads as a weapon coating instead of a poison.
- **Druid:** combo pips in Cat Form. Omen of Clarity is upkeep, and its Clearcasting proc shows in the ability slot.
- **Mage:** Arcane Blast stacks, Arcane Concentration's Clearcasting, and Fire Vulnerability from Improved Scorch. An active Mana Shield or Ice Barrier no longer hides a missing-armor message.
- **Priest:** Shadowform shows even when the game doesn't report it as a stance; Shadow Protection upkeep; Inner Focus cue.
- **Warlock:** Nightfall's Shadow Trance proc, every curse, Siphon Life and Unstable Affliction on the target and the DoT bars, and a Demonic Sacrifice buff counts in place of your demon.
- **Hunter:** Aspect of the Cheetah or Pack left on in combat is a warning. Hunter's Mark and an unhappy pet now also appear on the compact card.
- **Shaman:** a dual-wielded off-hand weapon without an imbue warns (shields never do), and the shield's last charge shows in red.

**Improvements**
- New commands: `fold`, `expand`, `autofold on|off` and `tray on|off`.
- **Reset settings** in the panel asks for a second click.
- The settings panel fits the default screen height.
- The Shaman bar updates only while a timer is counting; between fights it no longer runs four times a second.
- The compact card redraws only when something on it changes.
- Hover checks pause during loading screens.
- Minimap buttons returned from the tray keep their original frame level.
- A mail attempt that never got a result is dropped when you reopen the mailbox.

Use `/reload`. Automated checks use mocked APIs and the Forever client's spell table; Chinese-client tracking and the new class cues still need in-game confirmation.
